leads_phone_format.name: leads_phone_format
leads_phone_format.value: length("leads"."phone") = 13 AND "leads"."phone" GLOB '8801[3-9]*' AND "leads"."phone" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'

shipments_unchecked_pathao.name: shipments_unchecked_pathao
shipments_unchecked_pathao.where: "shipments"."provider" = 'pathao' AND "shipments"."status" IN ('delivered', 'partial') AND "shipments"."recipient_phone" IS NOT NULL AND "shipments"."delivery_checked_at" IS NULL

users_phone_format.name: users_phone_format
users_phone_format.value: length("users"."phone") = 11 AND "users"."phone" GLOB '01[0-9]*' AND "users"."phone" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
